q1: SELECT beer.name, min_price, bar FROM beer LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT beer, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM serves GROUP BY beer) AS t ON beer.name = t.beer LEFT OUTER JOIN serves ON beer.name = serves.beer AND min_price = serves.price
q2: WITH beer_prices AS (SELECT beer.name AS beer, MIN(s.price) AS min_price FROM beer LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON beer.name = s.beer GROUP BY beer.name), beer_bars AS (SELECT s.beer, s.price, s.bar FROM serves AS s JOIN beer_prices AS bp ON s.beer = bp.beer AND s.price = bp.min_price) SELECT bp.beer, bp.min_price AS price, bb.bar FROM beer_prices AS bp LEFT JOIN beer_bars AS bb ON bp.beer = bb.beer UNION ALL SELECT beer.name AS beer, NULL AS price, NULL AS bar FROM beer WHERE NOT beer.name IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.beer FROM serves AS s) ORDER BY beer
